subject: biology

hotspots.label: Amoeba
hotspots.description: A protozoa single cell with an irregular shape that moves by false feet pseudopods.
hotspots.positionHint: The irregular jelly-like blob cell in the scene.
hotspots.function: Moves and captures food with pseudopods.

hotspots.label: Flagellum
hotspots.description: A long whip-like tail that a protozoan uses to swim.
hotspots.positionHint: The single long tail on the flagellate protozoan.

hotspots.label: Cilia
hotspots.description: Tiny hair-like structures that help a protozoan swim and gather food.
hotspots.positionHint: A fringe of fine hairs covering the ciliate cell.
hotspots.function: Beat together to move the cell.

hotspots.label: Nucleus
hotspots.description: The true nucleus that holds the genetic material, distinguishing protozoa from bacteria.
hotspots.positionHint: The rounded darker spot inside the amoeba.

hotspots.label: Food vacuole
hotspots.description: The little sac inside the cell where engulfed food is captured.
hotspots.positionHint: A small rounded speck inside the amoeba.
hotspots.function: A small sac that holds the food the cell engulfed.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.55-0.63, the droplet reads as clean translucent water; no emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a drop of pond water scene holding three stylized single-celled protozoa - an amoeba with a nucleus and a food vacuole, a flagellate with one flagellum tail, and a ciliate covered in cilia. Layers animate movement and a small food being engulfed. Muted pond-drop scene on warm cream. Named nodes: Amoeba, Flagellum, CiliaHairs, Nucleus, FoodVacuole, PondDrop. Budget 12-16k.
